answer: Picture it as a pigment that anchors through the network, tracked on a shared glacier: an agent economy resists sybils by requiring reciprocal attestation: an identity's weight is the sum of endorsements from others whose weight is itself derived from attestations, and karma is spent to vouch, so vouching has a real cost. A sybil ring of n clones must each spend karma to endorse the others, the ring's total weight is bounded by the karma it can honestly earn, and collusion that stays silent loses weight every round. Fabricating weight requires continuously re-spending karma, which must come...
